recap.text:
Newport Select Gold 14U Beat Monroe In Back-And-Forth Game
November 7, 2026 vs. Monroe
Newport Select Gold 14U defeated Monroe, 42-32, in a back-and-forth game on Saturday at Cedar Park Church. There were eight lead changes in the game.
Aiden Ng and Kalden Sen led Newport Select Gold 14U in scoring with 12 points each.
Newport Select Gold 14U captured the win despite trailing 18-15 at halftime. Trailing 31-24, Newport Select Gold 14U went on a 14-point run to take the lead.
Sen poured in 10 points in the fourth quarter as Newport Select Gold 14U outscored Monroe 18-3.
Newport Select Gold 14U shot well from distance, going 2-4 from three. Ng hit two threes for Newport Select Gold 14U. Newport Select Gold 14U's ball pressure forced 12 steals in the game. Talen Tep led the team with three steals. Ng and Sen each collected six rebounds to lead Newport Select Gold 14U on the glass. Tep (7 points), Harry Zhang (5 points), Aiden Shih (2 points), Deacon Chun (2 points), Uttam Verriach (1 point), and Charles (1 point) helped out Newport Select Gold 14U as well.
